row: PAL Physiotherapy & Sports Rehab is a trusted physiotherapy clinic in Madhapur, Hyderabad, located near Durgam Cheruvu Metro Station, Hitech City, that is very close to Mindspace. We offer expert care for back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain, knee pain, and sports injuries. Our experienced physiotherapists and chiropractors use techniques like dry needling, cupping therapy, manual therapy, and exercise rehabilitation. We are specialized in sports rehab, geriatric physiotherapy, posture correction, strength training, Sciatica, Arthritis, Muscle pain treatment and post-surgical recovery. Book an appointment today for your personal pain relief treatment at physiotherapy in Madhapur on +91 8639398229
